[[File:Gregg Keefer Lasting Impression 1998.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Gregg Keefer, Gold 4.]]
'''Greg Keefer''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Gold 4 from Jacksonville, Fl. His slot was marked Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="sm-fan" />

Listed as Gregg Keefer, he ran the September 1996 tournament played by [[Shawn Valdez (player)|Shawn Valdez]], who died of leukemia the next day at 13. Valdez's parting words, "I just wanted to play", stayed with him. He worked as a commercial toy sculptor.<ref name="decsq-prof" />

== In their own words ==

<blockquote>
Being kind of an extroverted guy, I love being center stage at tournaments and helping kids to learn the game. To help them have fun as they "grow strong in the ways of the Force" is the icing on the cake for me.

The friends I've made and the experiences I have had as a result of this game are too numerous to mention. Thank you Decipher!<ref name="decsq-prof" />
</blockquote>
